chunks: Al-Mīthamī narrated from Abū Mūsā, who said:
I said to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: “May I be your ransom, can a man borrow and perform hajj?”
I said: “Can he borrow and get married?”
He said: “Yes, for he awaits the provision of Allah morning and evening.”

key_terms.رِزْقَ: provision or sustenance granted by Allah
key_terms.يَسْتَقْرِضُ: to borrow money or seek a loan

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible in Islam to borrow money for hajj or marriage?
ai.summary: This hadith indicates the permissibility of borrowing for important religious and life needs such as hajj and marriage. The Imam عليه السلام grounds this in trust that Allah provides sustenance continually, morning and evening.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3685 - Al-Mithami narrated from Abu Musa who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah (as)-"May I be your ransom! Can a man borrow and perform Hajj?"
I said: "Can he borrow and get married?"
Imam (as) said: "Yes, for he awaits the provision of Allah (swt) morning and evening."
